command.summary: Upload a file to a storage blob. Create a new blob from a file path, or updates the content of an existing blob with automatic chunking and progress notifications.

parameters.name: --auth-mode
parameters.help: The mode in which to run the command. "login" mode will directly use your login credentials for the authentication. The legacy "key" mode will attempt to query for an account key if no authentication parameters for the account are provided. Environment variable: AZURE_STORAGE_AUTH_MODE.

parameters.name: --blob-url
parameters.help: The full endpoint URL to the Blob, including SAS token and snapshot if used. This could be either the primary endpoint, or the secondary endpoint depending on the current `location_mode`.

parameters.name: --container-name
parameters.help: The container name.

parameters.name: --data
parameters.help: The blob data to upload. WARNING: Argument '--data' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --file
parameters.help: Path of the file to upload as the blob content.

parameters.name: --lease-id
parameters.help: Required if the blob has an active lease.

parameters.name: --length
parameters.help: Number of bytes to read from the stream. This is optional, but should be supplied for optimal performance. Cooperate with --data. WARNING: Argument '--length' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --name
parameters.help: The blob name.

parameters.name: --socket-timeout
parameters.help: The socket timeout(secs), used by the service to regulate data flow.

parameters.name: --encryption-scope
parameters.help: A predefined encryption scope used to encrypt the data on the service.

parameters.name: --max-connections
parameters.help: Maximum number of parallel connections to use when the blob size exceeds 64MB.

parameters.name: --metadata
parameters.help: Metadata in space-separated key=value pairs. This overwrites any existing metadata.

parameters.name: --no-progress
parameters.help: Include this flag to disable progress reporting for the command.

parameters.name: --overwrite
parameters.help: Whether the blob to be uploaded should overwrite the current data. If True, blob upload operation will overwrite the existing data. If set to False, the operation will fail with ResourceExistsError. The exception to the above is with Append blob types: if set to False and the data already exists, an error will not be raised and the data will be appended to the existing blob. If set overwrite=True, then the existing append blob will be deleted, and a new one created. Defaults to False.

parameters.name: --tags
parameters.help: Space-separated tags: key[=value] [key[=value]...]. Use '' to clear existing tags.

parameters.name: --tier
parameters.help: The tier value to set the blob to. For page blob, the tier correlates to the size of the blob and number of allowed IOPS. Possible values are P10, P15, P20, P30, P4, P40, P50, P6, P60, P70, P80 and this is only applicable to page blobs on premium storage accounts; For block blob, possible values are Archive, Cold, Cool, and Hot. This is only applicable to block blobs on standard storage accounts.

parameters.name: --timeout
parameters.help: Request timeout in seconds. Applies to each call to the service.

parameters.name: --type
parameters.help: Default to 'page' for *.vhd files, or 'block' otherwise.

parameters.name: --content-cache
parameters.help: The cache control string.

parameters.name: --content-disposition
parameters.help: Conveys additional information about how to process the response payload, and can also be used to attach additional metadata.

parameters.name: --content-encoding
parameters.help: The content encoding type.

parameters.name: --content-language
parameters.help: The content language.

parameters.name: --content-md5
parameters.help: The content's MD5 hash.

parameters.name: --content-type
parameters.help: The content MIME type.

parameters.name: --maxsize-condition
parameters.help: The max length in bytes permitted for an append blob.

parameters.name: --validate-content
parameters.help: Specify that an MD5 hash shall be calculated for each chunk of the blob and verified by the service when the chunk has arrived.

parameters.name: --acquire-policy-token
parameters.help: Acquiring an Azure Policy token automatically for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --change-reference
parameters.help: The related change reference ID for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --if-match
parameters.help: An ETag value, or the wildcard character (*). Specify this header to perform the operation only if the resource's ETag matches the value specified.

parameters.name: --if-modified-since
parameters.help: Commence only if modified since supplied UTC datetime (Y-m-d'T'H:M'Z').

parameters.name: --if-none-match
parameters.help: An ETag value, or the wildcard character (*). Specify this header to perform the operation only if the resource's ETag does not match the value specified. Specify the wildcard character (*) to perform the operation only if the resource does not exist, and fail the operation if it does exist.

parameters.name: --if-unmodified-since
parameters.help: Commence only if unmodified since supplied UTC datetime (Y-m-d'T'H:M'Z').

parameters.name: --tags-condition
parameters.help: Specify a SQL where clause on blob tags to operate only on blobs with a matching value.

parameters.name: --account-key
parameters.help: Storage account key. Must be used in conjunction with storage account name or service endpoint. Environment variable: AZURE_STORAGE_KEY.

parameters.name: --account-name
parameters.help: Storage account name. Related environment variable: AZURE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT. Must be used in conjunction with either storage account key or a SAS token. If neither are present, the command will try to query the storage account key using the authenticated Azure account. If a large number of storage commands are executed the API quota may be hit.

parameters.name: --blob-endpoint
parameters.help: Storage data service endpoint. Must be used in conjunction with either storage account key or a SAS token. You can find each service primary endpoint with `az storage account show`. Environment variable: AZURE_STORAGE_SERVICE_ENDPOINT.

parameters.name: --connection-string
parameters.help: Storage account connection string. Environment variable: AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING.

parameters.name: --sas-token
parameters.help: A Shared Access Signature (SAS). Must be used in conjunction with storage account name or service endpoint. Environment variable: AZURE_STORAGE_SAS_TOKEN.

parameters.name: --debug
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity to show all debug logs.

parameters.name: --help
parameters.help: Show this help message and exit.

parameters.name: --only-show-errors
parameters.help: Only show errors, suppressing warnings.

parameters.name: --output
parameters.help: Output format.

parameters.name: --query
parameters.help: JMESPath query string. See http://jmespath.org/ for more information and examples.

parameters.name: --subscription
parameters.help: Name or ID of subscription. You can configure the default subscription using `az account set -s NAME_OR_ID`.

parameters.name: --verbose
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity. Use --debug for full debug logs.
